However, neither the record nor the redirect-only attachment defines a technical topic from which an evidence-backed METSS-led work package can be established. Eligibility remains conditional because eligible applicant categories are listed, but METSS's applicable legal/status facts and NIH-specific submission requirements are unverified. The January 7, 2028 Grants.gov response date should not be treated as proof of an active or applicable receipt cycle. Investigate only after obtaining the complete authoritative NIH announcement and identifying a specific biomedical engineering concept; do not commit proposal resources yet.
analysis.immediate_action: Obtain and review the complete current PAR-25-321 NIH announcement from an authoritative NIH source, then verify the applicable receipt cycle, applicant/PI requirements, and METSS legal and registration eligibility. In parallel, require an internal go/no-go concept statement defining a specific bioengineering problem and a meaningful METSS testing, analytical, formulation, or development work package before deciding whether to pursue as a research partner or applicant.
